suite: annotate face suggestions (candidate colours, the pick, the switch)
expect_red: two callers that both ask for one part before either finishes get ONE body in the scene

mutations.contract: scene.loadPart is idempotent under concurrency. Its already-open check is synchronous and `this.parts.set` happens three awaits later, so two callers that both start before either finishes would each build a THREE.Mesh -- two bodies in the scene at two layout slots, one of them unreachable through `this.parts` and so impossible to hide, frame or dispose.
mutations.note: Two callers is the normal case since 2026-09-21: `goto` opens the element's part and the face-suggestion display opens the same one, started from `select-edge` and deliberately not awaited by a click handler. Their relative timing is not deterministic enough to be a guard, though -- measured, the mutated build stayed green through a real element arrival -- so the witnessing sub-check DRIVES the contract instead: two loadPart calls started before either finishes, and the bodies counted off the live scene graph. The mutation drops the shared in-flight promise and keeps the synchronous already-open check, which is the shape the hazard had.
mutations.find:
const inFlight = this._loading.get(sha256);
    if (inFlight) return inFlight;
mutations.replace:
const inFlight = null;
    if (inFlight) return inFlight;
